newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies eight issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies eight issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it qualified eight issues for insurance slated for competitive sale today.
--Alden-Conger ISD #242, Minn., $3 million of GO School building bonds.
--Hinckley ISD #2165, Minn., $4.3 million of GO school building bonds.
--Ortonville ISD $62, Minn., $8.9 million of GO school building bonds.
--Carroll Community School District, Iowa, $5.5 million of GO school bonds.
--Artesia Public School District #16, N.M., $5 million of GO bonds.
--East Penn SD, Pa., $10 million of GO bonds.
--Hudson School District, Wis., $16.9 million GO school bonds.
--Council Rock SD, Pa., $17 million GO bonds.
